notes.title: Update 1.3.31b
notes.content:
Update includes Royalty Free Music and Art to make the Hubworld feel alive and lived in!

New Abilities Available for the Warrior And Wizard!
Forge Powerful Artifacts with Materials found in the Dungeon!

A Stranger has come to the hubworld, he seems a little shady, and while the stuff he's selling isn't ready yet, it seems powerful!

Shadows and Light, Massive Overhaul to the Lighting, Shadows can now be cast in the dungeon and hub world, very pretty!

AI Optimizations, AI is now managed by a single AI control Object, Improving Frame-rate and allowing ease of integration for the future Multiplayer Update.

A refactor of how Damage Boxes Work, same functionality better execution. 
(Mostly so that Multiplayer Hosting Works Nicer!)

notes.title: Update 1.3.24a
notes.content:
This update reworks the dungeon generation algorithm to be based of a 'cheat sheet', this ensures that the dungeons look nicer, and have better designs for traps and rewards!

This update also has improved the quality of the Dialog System npc characters use, for ease of use. This includes a larger font size, and better controls for easy dialog navigation.

The Archer Class has been implemented in the game, however this is a dev implementation, the class is included as template for a future update wherein the class will receive it's own unique abilities and upgrades.
